decision_description: Delivered the two-part agnosticism test-of-done. (1) A pure, deterministic 'no project nouns' lint (runner/agnosticism_lint.py) scans the enumerated GENERIC graph layer for a denylist of instance-#1 project nouns (word-boundary + case-insensitive) and fails naming file:line:noun if any appears. It passes on the current generic layer. (2) A throwaway, unrelated second instance (tests/fixtures/agnosticism_second_instance/ — 'BorrowBrella', a community umbrella-lending network) compiles to valid Tier-3 + Part B docs/** artifacts through the SAME runner.graph_compiler used by the reference instance, with ONLY its graph.config.yaml + authored vault as the per-project layer — no runner code edited. The proof is captured here and as a self-documenting fixture README.

lint.scope: The GENERIC graph layer only: runner/graph_*.py (schema, config, compiler, pack deriver, projector) + runner/vault_*.py (reader, scaffolder) + templates/obsidian_graph_vault/ authored content (graph.config.yaml, README.md, vault/**/*.md) + .claude/skills/obsidian-graph/SKILL.md. 13 files scanned.
lint.scope_exclusions: OUT of scope by design: (a) the broader engine (call_slicer.py, dag_scheduler.py, unit_cost_budget.py, instrument_profile.py, ...) which is legitimately instrument-aware — MSCA-PF is instance #1's active instrument, a Tier-2A/2B fact the engine may name; (b) the reference vault MSCA/ and its graph.config.yaml, which ARE instance #1 (the per-project layer) and carry project nouns by design; (c) the vendored .obsidian/ Obsidian app dir (bundled Dataview plugin) — third-party, not authored generic-layer content, and would false-positive (minified Svelte 'Sv'+'elte' would hit a bare 'ELTE'). Word-boundary matching guards the authored layer; the vendored dir is excluded outright.
lint.denylist: Instance #1's real proper nouns + distinctive domain terms, grounded in the confirmed Tier-3 data (consortium/roles.json, project_brief/project_summary.json), plus the three the ticket names outright. Categories: instrument (MSCA); proper nouns (Cholakova, Rositsa, ELTE, Eötvös, Loránd, Jung, Cubert, Brightic, AgroVIR, Plovdiv, Budapest, Maritsa, and the mobility-path countries/nationalities Hungary/Hungarian/Bulgaria/Bulgarian); domain (crop, irrigation, tomato, hyperspectral, AquaCrop, PlanetScope, biostimulant). Generic words ('partner', 'impact', 'objective', 'outcome') are deliberately NOT denylisted — only partner NAMES are. A denylist is inherently non-exhaustive (it catches enumerated nouns, not every conceivable one); it is grounded in the confirmed Tier-3 spine and covers the ticket-named categories.

lint.one_leak_fixed: The lint's red→green surfaced exactly one project-noun leak it was designed to catch: runner/graph_compiler.py:53 named 'the current MSCA vault' in a docstring (also stale post-ticket-8: it claimed the binding nodes were 'not yet authored' and 'both slices compile empty'). Reworded to a generic, authoring-state-accurate paragraph. While correcting that staleness class, three sibling residual-diff EXPLANATION strings in the same file (the _diff_one 'residual' explanation and diff_against_hand_lift's 'convergence_basis' + 'note'), which still asserted 'not yet authored (ticket 8)' / 'convergence lands when ticket 8 authors', were generalized to be authoring-state-agnostic (pre-authoring vault → empty/residual; fully authored instance → converges). Those three carried NO project noun (the lint passed without touching them) and are report-string-only — no structural or behavioural change, no test pins the text; the generalization is a staleness correction, not a lint requirement. 62 graph-compiler tests unaffected.

The lint is a pure static check (reads source, reports; writes nothing, evaluates no gate — §17.6.2). The second instance compiles via the existing Step-0-style compiler to non-destructive staging (the real docs/** is never touched — tests stage under tmp). §13.3 upheld: no project fact is fabricated (the toy content is explicitly a throwaway, and the generic layer is proven noun-free). The graph_compiler.py edits are text-only (a docstring correction removing a leaked noun + stale claim, and three residual-diff EXPLANATION strings generalized to authoring-state-agnostic); no diff-report key, structure, or logic changed, so behaviour is unchanged. Enforces the §2 programme-/project-agnostic mission at the source level.
reproducibility: Both halves are re-runnable and deterministic: `py -3.10 -m runner.agnosticism_lint --repo-root .` (exit 0 clean, 1 on any leak) and the two committed test files.
